Argon2Params.description: Argon2id parameters. Memory is in KiB; `t_cost` is passes; `p_cost` is lanes.

Id.description:
A 128-bit identifier. It is written as the usual hyphenated UUID text in
every encoding, so CBOR, JSON, and file names all show the same string.

RecoveryState.description: Whether the person has a recovery kit, and whether it has been tried.

oneOf.description: No kit has been made. The only thing a manager may newly ask for (§7).
The kit was used once in a drill and it opened the identity.

Timestamp.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

description: One per person. Who manages the identity and how far recovery has got.

format_v.description: The store format major this profile was written under.

isk_pub.description: Public half of the Identity Signing Key, which signs every record.

kdf.description:
Password-stretching parameters for the recovery kit and the account
slot. Signed here so a relay cannot lower them (04-security §4).

manager.description:
The app that manages this identity (for example `lockdown`), or none.
While none, any app may write the profile (§2, §7).

sig.description: Ed25519 signature by the ISK over the record with `sig` empty.

title: Profile
